claim_scope: Evidence-informed stylized external fossil fragment based on Spyroceras melolineatum holotype UMUT PM18493; not complete conch, life reconstruction or exact replica.
purpose: Small museum cabinet/catalog specimen, close inspection; preserve real-world nominal size, no per-asset normalization.
historical_status: New candidate, not byte recovery, not historic accepted replay or new inventory count.

axes.blender: X lateral, -Y ventral/front view, Z long axis narrow-to-broad
axes.glb: X lateral, +Z ventral/front, Y long axis narrow-to-broad
axes.origin: Center of narrow fragment cut face at floor z=0; upright specimen mounting convention, not inferred life pose

scale_policy.length_definition: Preserved long-axis extent, not restored conch length or arclength
scale_policy.uncertainty: At least ±15%, conditional original-PDF print-scale calibration from magnification ×1.5; no independent scale bar.

art_direction.primary: One continuous tapering slender orthoconic fragment
art_direction.secondary: 33 softly rounded annulations in continuous surface, mildly uneven spacing
art_direction.tertiary: 32 restrained alternating stronger/weaker longitudinal geometric ribs, count an artistic approximation
art_direction.quiet_region: Broad mineral fracture faces; neutral palette without uniform random noise
art_direction.fractures: Oblique upper break, blunt lower cut; closed mineral faces are artistic inferred termination, not preserved soft anatomy or an aperture
art_direction.unseen_surface: Conservative circular wrap inferred from species cross-section; no photographic copying

coverage_justification: Explicit static-stylized-v1 eight-view scope: six canonical and clay/wire; additional hero/detail allowed. No coverage or scientific waiver.
